detail: Measured (image set 3e53d7bc5dbd72de73042b46e6174d316ef7a63d fn-host, --eval (sleep 6) before acl2::sbcl-restart, read at 3 s, three repeats): SBCL_USER_ARGS --dynamic-space-size 32000 -> VmRSS 259,508 kB, anon 47,492, file 210,497; 1068 -> 34,148 / 7,528 / 24,821; 4096 -> 34,508; 256 -> 34,480. So with the 32000 default SBCL faults every core page and ~40 MB more anon at start; the installed node passes the figure (host/native/heap.lisp fnn-heap-reservation) and is not affected (an unrelated live node sbcl under /tank/fn/node showed 61.5 MB RSS in ps), but every harness, test and tool that starts the published launcher without a figure measures and runs 225 MB heavier. Cause not established (not read from SBCL source); first step is strace of the 32000 start. Evidence hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/n-mem/EVIDENCE.txt, hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/n-mem/bare.sh.
notes: 2026-10-07 N-MEMSET: READY on lane/memset. tools/build_native_host.sh splices the saved launcher default --dynamic-space-size 32000 -> the small preset figure, derived by the built image itself (operator init under the preset fields of books/heap-figure.lisp *fn-heap-small-request*, reading reservation=MB: the figure the installed launcher decides for that profile); FN_NATIVE_DEFAULT_HEAP_MB overrides. Unit test uses a fake image and pins that the script flags equal the heap-book preset. The installed path (packaging/fn heap probe) and FN_TEST_HEAP_MB/SBCL_USER_ARGS still override (SBCL takes the last option); the native harness already goes through the installed launcher except image_heap opt-outs, which now start at the small figure unless they pass one. Evidence: MEMORY-20261006.md row 8, hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/n-mem/EVIDENCE.txt, bare.sh. OWED AT CONVERGENCE: the real probe (init on a built image) is untested locally (no image here); re-measure a bare start (expect ~34 MB RSS) and run the image_heap opt-out tests.
title: the published fn-host launcher defaults to --dynamic-space-size 32000: a start with no figure is 259 MB RSS, the same start at 1068 MB is 34 MB
